sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor-level applicant may apply to the PhD; degree must be completed before enrollment.
International applicants are included. This does not determine admission competitiveness. [s1] [s2]

Apply through Graduate School/ApplyWeb; choose Mathematics PhD. Arrange three academic referees,
transcripts, academic and personal statements, and required Math GRE. Select English exemption on the
application first page if qualifying; request fee waiver before payment. One application per term; field-transfer
exceptions need permission. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4] [s15]

students not confirmed. Old research-group pages contain emeriti; use current roster. [s1] [s13] [s14]

page; allow seven days for updates. Outside letter services require field coordination. [s3] [s4] [s5]

explicitly current. Stipend amounts available for 2026-27 only. [s1] [s10]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic unless exempt; no DET/PTE/TOEFL Essentials. IELTS overall 7; speaking 8 meets
Tier A, otherwise qualifying Tier B applicants need assessment. TOEFL before 21 January 2026: reading 20,
listening 15, writing 20, speaking 22 (Tier B) or 27 (Tier A). New scale: R4/L3.5/W4/S4 for Tier B, S5.5 for Tier A.
Scores valid two years at deadline; ETS code 2098. MyBest accepted centrally subject to field discretion. Home
testing only when safe in-person testing unavailable. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
U.S. bachelor’s completed by enrollment, with majority of physical attendance in the U.S., qualifies; select
exemption in application, no prior email permission. UChicago degree is therefore eligible if these conditions
hold. Exemption from admission testing does not remove the English Language Assessment/possible ITAP
teaching requirement. Alternative exemption covers two consecutive full-time English-medium study/work
years in an approved country in the last ten years with CV/transcript evidence. [s2]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not considered. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
REQUIRED; minimum 600. Applications with missing or below-600 Mathematics Subject GRE are not reviewed.

Three, with extra letters allowed. Prefer current/prior academic faculty able to assess academic work;
applicants away from school should ask field about professional referees. [s1] [s4]

instructions. Public page does not identify the exact save/send trigger or delay. FERPA choice must be made
before the request. [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2026-27 published rates, not a 2027-28 offer: Ithaca assistantship USD 36,684/9 months plus USD
12,228/13-week summer = USD 48,912/12 months. University Fellowship USD 36,684 academic plus USD
7,779 summer = USD 44,463/12 months. Math guarantees tuition, health insurance and stipend including
summer, but which fellowship/assistantship combination applies is in offer. Do not use Cornell Tech’s separate
rate. [s10] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted Mathematics PhDs receive five years including summers, conditional on satisfactory
progress/work. First-year fellowship is an aim, not a universal promise. Sixth-year support may be requested
before end of ninth semester with advisor copied, reason and completion date; not guaranteed. [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department states all admitted Math PhDs receive support, without a citizenship exception; inference:
international admits included. Individual external fellowships may restrict citizenship. [s9]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress and assigned duties. TA work averages at most 15 hours weekly; at least one summer TA
assignment, usually second/third year. At least 75% of TA assignments are recitation sections. External support
replaces internal support with possible supplement, not automatic double stipend; notify graduate field
coordinator. [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No additional reference/essay or separate application established for ordinary Mathematics recruitment
fellowships; department selects candidates during admission. Outside scholarships can impose distinct
questions, references and deadlines. [s9]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Recruitment fellowships; external fellowships; Hutchinson teaching-relief award after A exam; Torng summer
award; Battig/York awards after A exam; emergency assistance. Eligibility/deadlines vary and are not all
admission scholarships. [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 105 nonrefundable; credit/debit online at submission. Paying or obtaining waiver is final step and locks
application. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Complete application then request waiver on payment page at least three business days before program
deadline (10 December 2026 is calculated planning cutoff). Hardship explanation addresses
finances/home-country conditions. Hardship waiver available for fully funded doctoral/research-master’s
applicants or FAFSA-eligible applicants; Math PhD fits first route regardless of F-1 status, but approval not
guaranteed. Do not pay before decision. [s3]

Cornell University
United States · Mathematics PhD
2026 US News roster/rank verified separately
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Math GRE below 600 or missing prevents review.
• All supporting materials due 15 December 2026; no assumed letter grace period.
• AI assistance has unusually specific prohibitions and disclosure requirement.
• Summer stipend differs between fellowship and assistantship rates.
• Speh, Sen and Hubbard are emeritus; no assumption of new primary supervision.
Eligibility and preparation
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago bachelor-level applicant may apply to the PhD; degree must be completed before enrollment.
International applicants are included. This does not determine admission competitiveness. [s1] [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Apply through Graduate School/ApplyWeb; choose Mathematics PhD. Arrange three academic referees,
transcripts, academic and personal statements, and required Math GRE. Select English exemption on the
application first page if qualifying; request fee waiver before payment. One application per term; field-transfer
exceptions need permission. [s1] [s2] [s3] [s4] [s15]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
No pre-admission supervisor agreement listed. Use current faculty leads below; willingness to take new
students not confirmed. Old research-group pages contain emeriti; use current roster. [s1] [s13] [s14]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
ApplyWeb: submit only when complete; fee/waiver finalizes and locks application. Track materials in activity
page; allow seven days for updates. Outside letter services require field coordination. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Fall 2027 application opened mid-September 2026; 15 December 2026 deadline and mandatory Math GRE
explicitly current. Stipend amounts available for 2026-27 only. [s1] [s10]
Deadlines by stage
Academic application; Reference receipt; Test-score receipt; Supporting documents [2027
confirmed]
15 December 2026 for all application materials; clock/timezone not published in the checked math page.
Incomplete applications are not considered; late letters may not be reviewed. Required Math GRE must be
included; no public score/letter grace period established. [s1]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Ordinary departmental funding is attached to admission; same application deadline. Recruiting fellowship
candidates are selected by Mathematics. External fellowship deadlines remain separate. [s1] [s9]
Accepting an offer [Conflict]
Standing central page invokes 15 April for funded offers, with individual offer controlling reply. Exact 2027 offer

date must be checked; math says offers may continue until 15 April, which is not itself a reply deadline. Central
page includes an obsolete written-release-after-April-15 quotation; do not rely on that part as current CGS
policy. [s11] [s1]
English and GRE
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic unless exempt; no DET/PTE/TOEFL Essentials. IELTS overall 7; speaking 8 meets
Tier A, otherwise qualifying Tier B applicants need assessment. TOEFL before 21 January 2026: reading 20,
listening 15, writing 20, speaking 22 (Tier B) or 27 (Tier A). New scale: R4/L3.5/W4/S4 for Tier B, S5.5 for Tier A.
Scores valid two years at deadline; ETS code 2098. MyBest accepted centrally subject to field discretion. Home
testing only when safe in-person testing unavailable. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
U.S. bachelor’s completed by enrollment, with majority of physical attendance in the U.S., qualifies; select
exemption in application, no prior email permission. UChicago degree is therefore eligible if these conditions
hold. Exemption from admission testing does not remove the English Language Assessment/possible ITAP
teaching requirement. Alternative exemption covers two consecutive full-time English-medium study/work
years in an approved country in the last ten years with CV/transcript evidence. [s2]
GRE General [2027 confirmed]
Not considered. [s1]
GRE Mathematics [2027 confirmed]
REQUIRED; minimum 600. Applications with missing or below-600 Mathematics Subject GRE are not reviewed.
[s1]
Academic records
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload transcript for every institution attended, one file per institution. Official electronic transcripts required
after admission and acceptance. [s1]
Mathematics-course list; Course descriptions [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list/descriptions requirement established in the public math checklist; current
portal supplement, template, length and upload/link rule remain unverified. [s1]
Recommendation letters
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three, with extra letters allowed. Prefer current/prior academic faculty able to assess academic work;
applicants away from school should ask field about professional referees. [s1] [s4]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No additional reference/essay or separate application established for ordinary Mathematics recruitment
fellowships; department selects candidates during admission. Outside scholarships can impose distinct
questions, references and deadlines. [s9]
What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Enter referee name/contact information; system sends email containing recommendation form and upload
instructions. Public page does not identify the exact save/send trigger or delay. FERPA choice must be made
before the request. [s4]
Before versus after submission [Unresolved]
A recommendation request is described separately from final submission, but whether current Cornell Math

ApplyWeb sends immediately before final submission was not conclusively documented. Do not use Cornell
MBA portal instructions for this PhD. [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
After submission, ApplyWeb activity/checklist shows materials. Allow at least seven days for field updates
before asking about missing items. Submission confirmation is emailed. [s5]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
No public rule found for replacing an already-submitted letter or carrying letters to a later cycle.
Interfolio/outside-portal letters require field agreement; select mail method and coordinate with field, with risk
of missing standard questions. [s4]
Written materials
Academic CV / resume; Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary;
Publications list [Unresolved]
Not listed as a separate required item on the public Mathematics checklist. Required/optional status, exact
prompt/length/format and paper upload-versus-link permissions need current portal verification; do not
assume permission from silence. [s1]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required academic statement. Faithful prompt paraphrase: describe mathematical goals, preparation and
experiences, research roles/results, relevant scholarly work, Cornell field/faculty fit and career plans. Central
guidance suggests 1-2 pages in a standard font, name and program at top of each page; this is guidance, not a
verified math-specific hard cap. Upload in application; exact file restrictions and permission to link papers
unverified. [s1] [s7]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required. Faithful prompt paraphrase: explain background/experiences shaping graduate-study decision and
readiness; contributions to collaborative belonging and valuing different perspectives; persistence through
challenges. Complement rather than duplicate academic statement. No numerical limit or math-specific
formatting verified on public page; upload in application. [s6] [s1]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Include research interests/preparation and relevant faculty within academic SOP; separate research-interest
document not listed. Separate limit and optional-upload permission unverified. [s7] [s1]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate mathematics-course list/descriptions requirement established in the public math checklist; current
portal supplement, template, length and upload/link rule remain unverified. [s1]
Scholarship essays [Standing rule]
No additional reference/essay or separate application established for ordinary Mathematics recruitment
fellowships; department selects candidates during admission. Outside scholarships can impose distinct
questions, references and deadlines. [s9]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Generative-AI policy: brainstorming and limited grammar/vocabulary/citation help allowed, but AI outlining,
drafting, substantial rewriting or full translation prohibited. Any permitted AI use requires disclosure of
category, purpose and affected sections in SOP or personal statement. Review full policy before drafting. [s8]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2026-27 published rates, not a 2027-28 offer: Ithaca assistantship USD 36,684/9 months plus USD
12,228/13-week summer = USD 48,912/12 months. University Fellowship USD 36,684 academic plus USD
7,779 summer = USD 44,463/12 months. Math guarantees tuition, health insurance and stipend including
summer, but which fellowship/assistantship combination applies is in offer. Do not use Cornell Tech’s separate
rate. [s10] [s9]
Years of support [Standing rule]
All admitted Mathematics PhDs receive five years including summers, conditional on satisfactory
progress/work. First-year fellowship is an aim, not a universal promise. Sixth-year support may be requested
before end of ninth semester with advisor copied, reason and completion date; not guaranteed. [s9]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Department states all admitted Math PhDs receive support, without a citizenship exception; inference:
international admits included. Individual external fellowships may restrict citizenship. [s9]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Satisfactory progress and assigned duties. TA work averages at most 15 hours weekly; at least one summer TA
assignment, usually second/third year. At least 75% of TA assignments are recitation sections. External support
replaces internal support with possible supplement, not automatic double stipend; notify graduate field
coordinator. [s9]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
No additional reference/essay or separate application established for ordinary Mathematics recruitment
fellowships; department selects candidates during admission. Outside scholarships can impose distinct
questions, references and deadlines. [s9]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Recruitment fellowships; external fellowships; Hutchinson teaching-relief award after A exam; Torng summer
award; Battig/York awards after A exam; emergency assistance. Eligibility/deadlines vary and are not all
admission scholarships. [s9]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 105 nonrefundable; credit/debit online at submission. Paying or obtaining waiver is final step and locks
application. [s3]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Complete application then request waiver on payment page at least three business days before program
deadline (10 December 2026 is calculated planning cutoff). Hardship explanation addresses
finances/home-country conditions. Hardship waiver available for fully funded doctoral/research-master’s
applicants or FAFSA-eligible applicants; Math PhD fits first route regardless of F-1 status, but approval not
guaranteed. Do not pay before decision. [s3]
Conflicts and remaining checks
Conflicting sources [Standing rule]
Central acceptance page retains obsolete CGS written-release quotation; rely on actual 2027 offer/current CGS
guidance. Current faculty roster places Speh/Sen/Hubbard among emeriti, unlike older research listings.
Stillman personal paper/CV links return 404; primary papers used for recent evidence. [s11] [s13] [s14]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Confirm deadline timezone; portal CV/course/sample fields and file formats; exact reference-email trigger,
replacement/reuse; 2027-28 stipend/fees and offer reply date; current faculty supervision availability. Check
